about.title: Our Story
intro: The tears your dad tried to hide.
about.description:
We're Mario and Gabriela, a creative couple with more than 5 years of experience capturing weddings in an authentic and meaningful way. As a couple ourselves, we know how important it is to feel comfortable in front of the camera, so we focus on creating a relaxed atmosphere where you can be yourselves. 

 That's why we don't ask you to perform for the camera. We simply stay close, observe quietly, and let everything flow. The result? A cinematic wedding film full of genuine emotions and authentic moments. 

 Based in Playa del Carmen, we combine our strengths—Mario's creative eye and Gabriela's emotional storytelling—to create timeless films you'll treasure forever.
about.mario: The eye. Focused on composition, light, and moments that happen only once.
about.gabriela: The heart. Attuned to emotion, rhythm, and the invisible connections between people.
about.closing: Together, we tell love stories the way they are felt — honest, intimate, and timeless.

items.question: When will we receive our final wedding film?
items.answer: You will receive your edited film between 4 and 8 weeks, depending on the complexity of the project.

items.question: Can we choose the music?
items.answer: Yes, you can suggest music. I also offer a library with proper licenses for correct, legal use.

items.question: Do you require a deposit?
items.answer: Yes, a non-refundable deposit is required to hold your date. The remaining balance is due before the event.

items.question: Can we book photography only?
items.answer: Yes, with limited availability—but our standout experience is photo + video together so the story feels continuous. Many couples who come in for photos choose a combined package once they see how we work the day.

items.question: Do photo and video work together?
items.answer: When you book both, we plan as one team: same timing, same priorities, and no competing for your attention—so you can be present and at ease.

items.question: How many photos are delivered?
items.answer: Every wedding is different. We deliver a curated, edited selection focused on honest moments and portraits—never filler. Totals vary by hours and events; we cover that on a discovery call.

items.question: How does booking work?
items.answer: Write us with your date and venue. We confirm availability, recommend the best option (film-first or photo + film), and send a simple agreement with a deposit to hold the date.
